name: Promenade Beach & French Quarter Walk
description: Scenic 1.5 km seaside promenade along Goubert Avenue lined with French colonial villas, the French War Memorial, and Gandhi Statue.

name: Auroville Matrimandir & Peace Area
description: Universal township and architectural wonder featuring the golden geodesic Matrimandir sphere, amphitheatre, and tranquil Banyan Tree gardens.

name: Sri Aurobindo Ashram
description: Serene spiritual retreat founded in 1926 by Sri Aurobindo and Mirra Alfassa (The Mother), featuring the flower-covered Samadhi.

name: Paradise Beach & Chunnambar Boat House
description: Pristine golden sand beach accessible via scenic backwater boat ride along the Chunnambar river, perfect for water sports and swimming.

name: White Town French Cafes & Bakery Trail
description: Charming heritage boulevard walk tasting authentic French croissants, artisanal sourdough pizzas, and crepes in colonial courtyard cafes.
